notes: createBackupForSelectedServer and createAutoBackupForServer -- the timer, stop-time, and manual-button call sites -- never pass slotId/slotName, so every ordinary backup goes through this fallback (lines 161-163) via activeWorldSlotMetadata (138-141), which reads WorldSlotManager.activeSlot(forServerDir:). If there is no active slot at all, the function returns (nil, nil, nil) (line 165) and the sidecar's slot fields all stay nil.
